knownFailures.cause: The README.md line 573 documents `bun add axios` but the Docker base image `node:19` does not include Bun; running the command fails with `bun: command not found` (exit 127) because Bun must be installed separately before it can be used.
knownFailures.fix: Before running `bun add axios`, install Bun first: `curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash` (and reload your shell or export `~/.bun/bin` onto PATH).
